newsitem.title: FRANCE: Synthelabo sees sales, net/shr rise in 97.
newsitem.headline: Synthelabo sees sales, net/shr rise in 97.

text.p: French pharmaceuticals company Synthelabo said on Tuesday it expected sales to rise by about 10 percent in 1997, that growth in its net profit per share should be higher than this and that it aimed for increasing profits in coming years through acquisitions as well as organic growth.
"In 1997, reported sales growth should be around 10 percent and net profit group share should increase at a higher rate than sales," it said in a statement.

"For the year 2000, the objective of Synthelabo is to reach sales of 18 to 20 billion French francs via organic growth and acquisitions and to record annual growth in earnings per share of 15 to 20 percent," it said.
